install: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const url = new URL("/pair", process.env.T3CODE_DEV_PUBLIC_URL); url.hash = new URLSearchParams({ token: process.env.T3CODE_DEV_AUTH_TOKEN }).toString(); fs.mkdirSync(".t3", { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(".t3/homemade-sign-in.txt", url.href + "\n", { mode: 0o600 });'

web.cmd: cd apps/web && exec pnpm exec vp dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --strictPort
